newsitem.title: USA: Delta, China Southern seek code-share approval.
newsitem.headline: Delta, China Southern seek code-share approval.

text.p: Delta Airlines Inc said it filed an application with the U.S. Department of Transportation seeking authority to operate code-share flights with China Southern Airlines to and from China.

Delta and China Southern signed a preliminary agreement on April 1 under which Delta would purchase seats on the four-times-per-week Boeing 777-200 service between Los Angeles and Guangzhou due to begin on July 20.
Delta's application seeks approval to code-share on this service beginning in late October.

Also under the agreement, China Southern would buy seats on Delta flights from Los Angeles to 13 destinations, including New York, Atlanta, Boston, Portland, Ore., and Washington D.C. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
